entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk Planeswalker who returns to her home plane Zendikar with Thassa's stolen bident and sets out to fight Ulamog at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Turi
entities.description: Kiora's younger sister, who studied at Sea Gate and waits for Kiora to return.

entities.name: Yenai
entities.description: An old, scarred Sejiri merfolk who leads the refugee group heading to Murasa.

entities.name: Elder Misha
entities.description: A merfolk matriarch who tells Cosi stories to the children.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The sea god of Theros whose bident Kiora stole.

entities.name: Ula
aliases: Ula, the sea god of Zendikar's merfolk
entities.description: The highest god of Zendikar's merfolk, since unmasked as the Eldrazi titan Ulamog.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: The trickster god of Zendikar's merfolk, since unmasked as the Eldrazi titan Kozilek.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A god of Zendikar's merfolk of the sky realm, since unmasked as the Eldrazi titan Emrakul.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan still on Zendikar, whom Kiora means to confront at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan unseen for months.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan unseen for months.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monsters that now invade Zendikar's oceans.

entities.name: The bident
entities.description: Thassa's stolen god-weapon, now dried like coral, which lets Kiora control the sea.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Kiora's home plane being devoured by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Kiora fought Thassa.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city overrun by the Eldrazi that Kiora decides to go to.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: The destination across the sea of Yenai's refugees.

entities.name: The merfolk refugees
entities.description: A hundred merfolk survivors from many tribes fleeing the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Flashback: As children, Kiora and Turi listen to Elder Misha's Cosi story about Cosi swapping Ula's spear for a feather.
events.quote: Cosi snuck to Ula's bedside at the bottom of the sea and swapped his great spear for a gull's feather

events.summary: Kiora planeswalks to Zendikar still clutching Thassa's bident, which dries to coral.
events.quote: There, still clutched tightly in both hands, was the weapon of a god.

events.summary: Kiora finds a beach of grey Eldrazi dust and senses dead places across the sea.
Kiora finds an altar to the Three in a cave and spits in Ula's face before sleeping beneath Cosi's statue.
events.quote: And she spit in Ula's blank, stupid face.

events.summary: Kiora uses the bident and sea creatures to drive Eldrazi off a hundred merfolk refugees.
events.quote: A vortex formed near one of the Eldrazi, sending it tumbling.

events.summary: Kiora reunites with her sister Turi, who tells her Kozilek and Emrakul have not been seen for months and that Ulamog is at Sea Gate.
events.quote: "No one's seen him in months," she said.

events.summary: Kiora announces she will go to Sea Gate to stop Ulamog, and Yenai says his group will flee to Murasa.
events.quote: "Depends," said Kiora. "I'm going to Sea Gate."

events.summary: Kiora tells a Cosi story about a mortal who steals Ula's spear, calling a wave that parts around the merfolk.
events.quote: A great wave broke over and around her

events.summary: Kiora promises Turi she will return, and half a dozen of Cosi's devotees follow her on a serpent toward Sea Gate.
events.quote: And half a dozen of the merfolk quietly came and stood beside her.

relations.note: Stole her bident after a fight.
relations.quote: fleeing Theros with the sea god's sacred weapon in hand.
ready to fight the monstrous Eldrazi that threaten her world with destruction.

relations.note: Zendikar's merfolk gods were unmasked as the titans.
relations.quote: since unmasked as the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul.

relations.note: Gives the group orders and speeches.
